title: Dec 9 rate call: one variable mortgage, hike or hold
caption: Variable rate mortgage, Dec 9: what a Bank of Canada hike adds to the payment, and what a hold changes (nothing). Illustrative, not an offer.

sources.fact: Policy rate 2.50% after the Oct 28 hike; prime 4.70% since Oct 29; decision Dec 9 at 9:45 a.m. ET
Dec 9 hike odds about 63-66% on Nov 13 (BlueGamma OIS; Reuters)
Governor Macklem speaks in Toronto Nov 24 (Economic Club of Canada)
